        la   gp, _global_pointer

        mv   t1, zero
        mv   t2, zero
        mv   s0, zero
        mv   s1, zero
        mv   a1, zero
        mv   a2, zero

        mv   s9, zero
        mv   s10, zero
        mv   s11, zero

        mv   t4, zero
        mv   t5, zero
        mv   t6, zero

        la   a0, __bss_start__
        la   a1, __bss_end__
        call crt_section_clear
